verdict.rationale: There is a first-party doc entry titled 'Get started with the screen reader' confirming accessibility/screen reader features exist, but the evidence pack has no detail on setup during install, other accessibility tools (magnifier, contrast, keyboard nav), or any switcher-focused hands-on validation. Missing for 10: detailed screen reader onboarding docs, coverage of other accessibility tools (magnifier, high-contrast, on-screen keyboard), independent/community confirmation of ease-of-use for switchers.
